title: The Science of Evaluating Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using standardized schemas (e.g., Winogender for pronoun resolution), occupational datasets (Bias-in-Bios), context-specific chat templates (TWBias), and counterfactual fairness approaches where sensitive attributes are altered.

Measured using question sets designed to reveal social biases against protected classes (e.g., BBQ), chat templates assessing stereotypes (TWBias), and fairness metrics evaluating consistency of model predictions across demographic groups.
Assessed using culturally tailored benchmarks (e.g., TWBias for Traditional Chinese contexts) to identify localized societal stereotypes embedded in model outputs.
Evaluated under the framework of individual fairness, using predictive datasets (e.g., ADULT, COMPAS) to measure whether inputs differing only in age receive equitable predictions or scores.
